The '''Campfire''' is a [[Crafting#Lighting|crafted lighting item]].  It provides light at night.  Right-clicking on the campfire toggles the fire on and off.

==Trivia==
*The Campfire outside [[Linus]]' [[Tent]] can be toggled on and off, with no effect on Linus' dialogue or behavior.
